mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_agent_model_request m JOIN afv_agent_run r ON r.run_id = m.run_id WHERE r.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m.status = 'UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION' AND m.permit_held = TRUE

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_agent_model_request WHERE model_id = #{modelId} AND permit_held = TRUE) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_canvas_text_job WHERE model_id = #{modelId} AND permit_held = TRUE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_agent_model_request(id, run_id, model_id, request_owner, request_epoch, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{runId}, #{modelId}, #{owner}, #{epoch}, 'RUNNING', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_agent_model_request SET status = 'COMPLETED', permit_held = FALSE, response_received_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE afv_agent_model_request SET status = 'UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION', revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM afv_agent_model_request WHERE id = #{id} AND run_id = #{runId} AND request_owner = #{owner} AND request_epoch = #{epoch} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_agent_model_request m JOIN afv_agent_run r ON r.run_id = m.run_id SET m.status = 'UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION', m.revision = m.revision + 1, m.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE m.status = 'RUNNING' AND (r.status <> 'RUNNING' OR r.owner_instance_id IS NULL OR r.owner_instance_id <> m.request_owner OR r.owner_epoch <> m.request_epoch OR r.lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) OR r.deadline_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
UPDATE afv_agent_model_request SET status = 'CANCELLED', permit_held = FALSE, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
